name: DESLORATADINE 5 MG 10 TABLETS
description: Desloratadine 5 mg, in a 10-tablet presentation, is an antihistamine used to relieve allergy symptoms. It works by blocking histamine, the substance responsible for the symptoms of allergic rhinitis (sneezing, runny and itchy nose) and urticaria (hives and itchy skin). If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
